steps.caption: Domains
steps.narration: This is Domains. It keeps your domains and your clients' in one list, and checks each one every day.

steps.caption: Porkbun or Name.com
steps.narration: Connect a Porkbun or Name.com API key to import domains. Here, two accounts are connected.

steps.caption: Any other registrar
steps.narration: Domains at any other registrar can be added by name, to be monitored too.

steps.caption: Domain inventory
steps.narration: The inventory lists all eight, with the registrar, the client location, and the last DNS check.

steps.caption: Expiry and auto-renew
steps.narration: This one expires in twenty-six days, and its auto-renew is off. Both show right on the row.

steps.caption: Needs attention
steps.narration: Choose Needs attention to list only the domains that need a look.

steps.caption: Expiring soon, auto-renew off
steps.narration: Three are expiring within sixty days or have auto-renew off. A failed HTTPS check lands here too.

steps.caption: Previews and change history
steps.narration: On a connected registrar, every DNS change starts as a preview, listed here with its history.

steps.caption: Open a preview
steps.narration: Open one to see what would change.

steps.caption: Before and after, with a warning
steps.narration: This one adds a TXT record. Changes that can affect email carry a warning like this one.

steps.caption: Nothing changes until you confirm
steps.narration: Nothing reaches the registrar until you tick a preview and choose Review and confirm.

steps.caption: Checked against public DNS
steps.narration: Once a change is applied, it is checked against public DNS until the new values show.

steps.caption: Registrar walkthroughs
steps.narration: For registrars without a connection here, Registrar walkthroughs give step-by-step guides.

steps.caption: Menu: Domains
steps.narration: You'll find Domains in the menu on the left, under Google Business.

youtube.title: Domains in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Domains in ConstructHUB: one list of your and your clients' domains, a daily check for expiry, auto-renew and DNS changes, a Needs attention filter, and DNS changes that start as a preview you confirm.
